in_sanskrit.name: सव्पन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Swpan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sva' meaning 'self' and 'pan' meaning 'all'. It denotes one who possesses all things in abundance and is prosperous and wealthy.

in_hindi.name: सवपन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi translation of Swpan is 'सम्पूर्ण' (sampūrṇ), which means 'complete' or 'full'. This name is often used to denote someone who has everything in abundance and is prosperous.

in_tamil.name: சுவப்பன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of Swpan is 'சுவப்பன்' (cuvappan), which is derived from the Tamil words 'சுவ' (cuvu) meaning 'all' and 'ப்பன்' (pannan) meaning 'lord' or 'master'. This name denotes someone who is the lord or master of all things.

in_marathi.name: Swpan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Swpan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who controls the sky and the rain. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'svapna', meaning 'dream'.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Sky
